verdict.rationale: Runway is a generative video platform, so lip-sync applies, but nothing in the evidence documents characters speaking supplied dialogue with lip movement matched to audio. The pack only mentions related things: conversational Characters/Avatars with custom voices, voice generation, and Seedance accepting audio references. None of these states that lip motion is synchronized to user-provided dialogue.

support.subject: As a creator, generated characters speak my dialogue with lip movement matched to the audio
